REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, January 14, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Waronek
d.
Roll Call
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department - Introduction of Sheriff's Deputy - Lomita Station
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
a.
Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department - Introduction of Sheriff's Deputy - Lomita Station
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular City Council Meetings held on December 10, 2014
MOTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item 7b
c.
Resolution 2014-48, Approving the Demands and Payroll.
MOTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item 7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
MOTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
MOTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7e
f.
Monthly Report for Community Development Department.
MOTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7f
g.
Monthly Report for Parks and Recreation Department.
MOTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department.
MOTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7h
i.
November 2014 Treasurer's Report.
MOTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7i
j.
Set the 2015 Council Meeting Dates
MOTION: That the City Council approve the 2015 Council Meeting dates.
Item 7j
k.
Authorize the Public Works Director to sign the Notice of Completion (NOC) and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $12, 380 to Advanced Industrial Services, Inc. for the Harbor Hills Water Storage Tank Rehabilitation Project
Staff recommends that City Council approve:
1)
Accept the work performed by Advanced Industrial Services, Inc.;
2)
Authorize the City Clerk to file the attached NOC with the County Recorder's Office;
3)
Authorize the Director of Public Works to sign the NOC and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $12,380 to Advanced Industrial Services, Inc., 35 calendar days after recordation of the NOC by the County Recorder's Office contingent upon no claims being filed on the project and the contractor posting an acceptable warranty bond.
Item 7k
l.
Approval of Amendment No. 2 to the City Manager Employment Agreement
MOTION: That the Council approve Amendment No. 2 to the City Manager Agreement.
Item 7l
PUBLIC HEARINGS
8.
PUBLIC HEARING - AN ORDINANCE AMENDING LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 11-1.51.02(A)( AMENDING SECTION 11.1.51.02(A)(30) TO PERMIT RETAIL CIGAR SALES WITH OR WITHOUT ACCESSORY SMOKING LOUNGES Recommendations:
1)
Introduce on first reading an ordinance amending Section 11-1.51.02(A)(30) of the Lomita Municipal Code permitting retail cigar or tobacco sales with or without accessory smoking lounges within the MC (Light Manufacturing Commercial) Zone only;
2)
Accept the categorical exemption for the project; and
3)
Direct staff to schedule the second reading and adoption of the ordinance for the January 28, 2015, City Council meeting. Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Item 8
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
9.
RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE 2014 GENERAL PLAN ADVISORY COMMITTEE (GPAC) Recommendations:
1.
Receive presentation from the GPAC.
2.
Receive and file GPAC recommendations. Presented by GPAC Chair Bob Steinbach
Item 9
10.
COUNCIL COMMITTEE ASSIGNMENTS. Recommendation:
Designate Council Committee assignments for 2015.
Item 10
11.
STUDY SESSION REGARDING A DRAFT FIVE YEAR WATER RATE STUDY. Recommendation:
Review the draft water rates and confirm the rate hearing date of February 11, 2015.
Presented by Brian Jewett, Black & Veatch
Item 11
12.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be on January 28, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
